pr_title: feat(compiler): add support for safe calls in templates
pr_body:
Adds support for safely calling functions that may be undefined inside template expressions. E.g. `maybeUndefined?.()`

Fixes #42298.

issue_context.title: Support safe function calls in templates
issue_context.body:
This ticket is a followup from PR #41911, which introduces safe keyed read expressions. We should also consider adding a support for safe function calls in templates such as:

```
{{ someObj.method?.() }}
```

See https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/41911#issuecomment-840828102 (and related discussion in PR #41911) for additional information.
comments: I'll look into adding this once https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/41911 is merged since it'll touch the same files.
